records.title: Chief Financial Officer
records.description: Duties: financial strategy, accounting controls, audit and staff leadership. Required: active CPA, bachelor degree in finance/accounting/business and ten financial-leadership years.

records.title: Director, Individual Giving
records.description: Duties: major gifts, donor strategy and individual giving. Required: seven to ten nonprofit-fundraising years. CFRE preferred; bachelor degree or equivalent experience. Entry-level donations are a gift channel, not job seniority.

records.title: Program Co-Director, Head of Research, Sovereign Debt Forum
records.description: Duties: sovereign-debt forum research and academic program co-direction. Two to four research years expected; graduate economics/finance training strongly preferred. General political science research may not supply specialist debt expertise.

records.title: Assistant Director of Individual Giving
records.company: Academy of Hope Adult Public Charter School
records.description: Duties: individual giving and development. Required: five to seven fundraising years. Assistant-director title does not imply early-career eligibility.

records.title: Managing Director of Development, Roosevelt Institute
records.description: Duties: build and lead individual giving program and manage staff. Required: eight to ten nonprofit-fundraising years and major gifts record.

records.title: Managing Director of Library Philanthropy, FDR Presidential Library and Museum
records.description: Duties: library philanthropy and major/principal gifts. Required: eight to ten nonprofit-fundraising years and staff/budget management record.

records.title: Director, Corporate Partnerships (Technology Sector)
records.description: Duties: corporate technology partnerships and major investments. Required: bachelor degree and ten or more corporate-partnership/business-development years with technology-sector experience. Masters preferred.
